camel_example: aliyun resourcemanager UpdateControlPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --NewDescription ExampleControlPolicy --NewPolicyName NewControlPolicy --NewPolicyDocument '{"Version":"1","Statement":[{"Effect":"Deny","Action":["ram:UpdateRole","ram:DeleteRole","ram:AttachPolicyToRole","ram:DetachPolicyFromRole"],"Resource":"acs:ram:*:*:role/ResourceDirectoryAccountAccessRole"}]}' --PolicyId 'cp-jExXAqIYkwHN0000'
description_en: Updates a custom access control policy
description_zh: 调用UpdateControlPolicy修改自定义管控策略
kebab_example: aliyun resourcemanager update-control-policy --policy-id cp-jExXAqIYkwHN0000 --new-policy-name NewControlPolicy --new-description ExampleControlPolicy --new-policy-document '{"Version":"1","Statement":[{"Effect":"Deny","Action":["ram:UpdateRole","ram:DeleteRole","ram:AttachPolicyToRole","ram:DetachPolicyFromRole"],"Resource":"acs:ram:*:*:role/ResourceDirectoryAccountAccessRole"}]}' --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateControlPolicy

parameters.help_en: The ID of the access control policy
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The new name of the access control policy.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length. The name can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-) and must start with a letter
parameters.help_zh:
新的管控策略名称。

长度为1~128个字符，必须以英文字母开头，可以包含英文字母、数字和短划线（-）
parameters.name: new_policy_name

parameters.help_en:
The new description of the access control policy.

The description must be 1 to 1,024 characters in length. The description can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-) and must start with a letter
parameters.help_zh:
新的管控策略描述。

长度为1~1024个字符，必须以英文字母开头，可以包含英文字母、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: new_description

parameters.help_en:
The new document of the access control policy.

The document can be a maximum of 4,096 characters in length.

For more information about the languages of access control policies, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179096.html.

For more information about the examples of access control policies, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181474.html
parameters.help_zh:
新的管控策略内容。

最大长度为4096个字符。

管控策略语言，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179096.html。

管控策略示例，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181474.html
parameters.name: new_policy_document

ControlPolicy.description_en: The details of the access control policy

AttachmentCount.description_en: The number of times that the access control policy is referenced
AttachmentCount.description_zh: 管控策略被引用的次数

CreateDate.description_en: The time when the access control policy was created

Description.description_en: The description of the access control policy

EffectScope.description_en:
The effective scope of the access control policy. Valid values:

All: The access control policy is in effect for Alibaba Cloud accounts, RAM users, and RAM roles.
RAM: The access control policy is in effect only for RAM users and RAM roles
EffectScope.description_zh:
管控策略生效范围。取值：

All：表示该管控策略针对阿里云账号、RAM用户或RAM角色生效。
RAM：表示该管控策略仅针对RAM用户或RAM角色生效

PolicyId.description_en: The ID of the access control policy

PolicyName.description_en: The name of the access control policy

PolicyType.description_en:
The type of the access control policy. Valid values:

System: system access control policy
Custom: custom access control policy
PolicyType.description_zh:
管控策略类型。取值：

System：系统管控策略。
Custom：自定义管控策略

UpdateDate.description_en: The time when the access control policy was updated
